title: PUBLIC WORKS COMMITTEE REPORT and CATEGORICAL EXEMPTION relative to the name of the private driveway at 6th Street east of Harbor Boulevard being…
text:
[Council File 26-0976; CD 15]
[Items Noticed for Public Hearing]
PUBLIC WORKS COMMITTEE REPORT and CATEGORICAL EXEMPTION relative to the name of the private driveway at 6th Street east of Harbor Boulevard being established as Sampson Circle.
Recommendation(s) for Council action:
1. FIND that the name establishment is exempt from the California Environmental Quality Act of 1970, pursuant to Article III, Class 5(4) of the City’s Environmental Guidelines.
2. FIND that the name of the private driveway at 6th Street east of Harbor Boulevard, shown on Exhibit A of the City Engineer report dated July 2, 2026, attached to the Council file, be established as Sampson Circle.
3. INSTRUCT the City Clerk to transmit the following:
a. A copy of the Council’s action on this matter to the Board of Supervisors of the County of Los Angeles pursuant to Section 34092 of the Government Code.
b. A copy of the Council’s action on this matter to the Department of Transportation, Bureau of Development Services, West Los Angeles and Coastal Development Review, 100 South Main Street, 10th floor, CALTRANS BUILDING, Los Angeles, CA 90012, ladot.devreview.wla@lacity.org.
c. A copy of the Council’s action on this matter to the Department of Transportation, Sign Manufacturing Shop, 555 Ramirez Street, Los Angeles, CA 90012, Sign Shop Supervisor, Dale Cruz.
Fiscal Impact Statement:
The City Engineer reports that a fee of $4,628.82 was collected pursuant to Section 18.09 of the Los Angeles Municipal Code. Neither the City Administrative Officer nor the Chief Legislative Analyst has completed a financial analysis of this report.
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
summary: Names the private driveway off 6th Street, east of Harbor Boulevard, Sampson Circle.
